# Tiikme

> India's verified professional identity platform for students, doctors, engineers, freelancers, and every working person. Build your verified profile, join Circles, find opportunities.

Tiikme is a professional social network built in India. Members create a verified professional identity, join topic-based Circles, post Work projects, request peer and institutional verification, and discover opportunities. Pages exist for individuals, organizations (companies, institutions, government bodies), and the Work projects they ship.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Tiikme is and who it's for.
- [Sign in](/signin): Existing member sign in.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a new Tiikme account.
- [Join as Institution](/join-as-institution): Onboard a company, college, or government body.
- [Welcome](/welcome): Post-signup welcome and next steps.

## Legal

- [Terms of Service](/terms): Platform terms.
